correctness.rationale: Every large roof event lies in one of two thin corner wedges. Exact integration yields m(E_R)~2/R^2 and conditional V=R min(a,b) with CDF v^2. Both wedge types enter a near-diagonal pair (u,u-d) within at most two iterates; all index-two steps are an arithmetic progression, and the exact first-exit ceiling formula implies tau_R=(2d)^{-1}+O(1), uniformly. Hence the conditioned Pareto clock and the uniform macroscopic diagonal profile follow by continuous mapping. Exact-rational replay of 120 finite cusp states checks critical branch identities, without substituting for asymptotic proof.
